The Glossary

Search for a word in English or a root in SimHebrew, using your browser find feature.

Note that not all commonly used 'Biblical' words are used in this translation. And some I have used but rarely, like appease or propitiate or obey. I allowed appeasing of Yahweh only from a pagan speaker. I did use obey for a rare stem. Instead of obey, I have retained the Hebrew construction hear with the voice of the other.

I found no use for any of the following words: law (see instruction), soul (see e.g. self / being), loving-kindness (see kind), punish (see visit), atonement (see cover), repent (see turn), and dominion (see rule).
